Today we explore the mysterious side of Seychelles, an African island nation famous for its beaches, giant tortoises and tropical jungles.
In this Seychelles travel vlog in Hindi, we explore Mahé Island by rental car, visit Anse Soleil and other peaceful beaches, discover the famous Aldabra giant tortoises and enjoy authentic Seychellois fish curry.
